MANDAN, MEDORA, MILES CITY, BILLINGS,
BOZEMAN, HELENA, THE DALLES AND PORTLAND.
ABATTOIRS

ST. PAUL, MEDORA, MILES CITY,
BILLINGS AND THE DALLES.

sells: Dressed beef and game from its abattoirs via a chain of cold-storage houses; public cold storage for vegetables and fruit
pitch: Scale and modernity: a long roll of cities from St. Paul to Portland; prestige of the Marquis de Mores as president; convenience to citizens who 'may also use these houses'
notes: Largest display ad in the issue (two columns wide). The Marquis de Mores founded Medora; his abattoir and refrigerated-car beef venture is the town's founding enterprise. Von Hoffman was the family name of de Mores's in-laws; the ad's 'A. VON HOFFMAN' is not further identified here. Category 'other' = meatpacking/cold storage.

We can speak with authority as to their quality, Mr. Cook having donated a bag to the office.' — a candid look at how editorial puffs and paid notices worked together. Directory lists it in Dec. 11; earliest confirmed Dec. 4, 1884.

notes: D. Flynn of Mandan visited Medora on business in Feb. 1884 (local item, 1884-02-14).

MEDORA, DAK.

IN

We Know and Attend to our Business!
Sole Agents for WILSON BROS. SHIRTS. | Sole Agents for Burts' Selz' and Hanan's LADIES' BOOTS AND SHOES! | Sole Agents for STETSON HATS.

Sole Agents for —Hanan and Selz'— FINE BOOTS.

T. W. GORDON, Manager,
